[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Maximum height by stacking cuboids** [LC 1691 · Maximum Height by Stacking Cuboids](https://leetcode.com/problems/maximum-height-by-stacking-cuboids/){difficulty="Hard"}

Rotation means you choose which side stands up. Sorting the three sides of a box and always using the largest as the height does not lose an optimal stack: if a box can sit under another in some orientation, it can sit under it after both have been sorted. Once every box is sorted, sorting the boxes themselves puts smaller bases first, and the stack is a weighted chain under $\le$ on all three coordinates.

[Solved in full in @sec-lis-p2-cube.]{.card-link}

:::
